title: 第8章 最后的准备第9章 再次上路
content_zh:
伴随着骨骼的噼啪弹响声，凯斯站了起来。
两米高的半兽人就像是堵肉墙似的站在来者面前，他低头看着对方道：“咱能把你的下巴撕下来，小东西。”
坐在一边的柯林握紧桌子上的酒杯，随时准备帮忙。
现在凯斯已经顶上去了，作为队友的他自然也不会退缩……不过他还没见过凯斯在战斗之外时露出有如此愤怒的表现。
过来的冒险者虽然有些发憷，但还是寸步不让。
他们也没办法，没工作就意味着没钱，没钱就意味着活不下去。
与其等着工作过来，不如主动去找。
哪怕这意味着会起冲突。
“老黑心，帮帮忙！”鲍勃扭头冲着酒馆老板喊道：“给这些小伙子一人一杯冰啤酒，让他们冷静下来。”
老板摆了摆手，酒馆侍女便捏着啤酒走到桌边。
几个来抢活的冒险者一看这车夫认识老板，顿时平静了下来。
犹豫一阵过后，只得默默走开。
敢在城外贫民窟经营酒馆的一般都不是简单角色，至少几个低阶冒险者肯定是惹不起的。
对方走了之后，凯斯咕哝了两声也坐回了原位。
“就是这样，和上次一样八个银币，你们跟我去一趟北边，可以吗？路程差不多。”
鲍勃没去管刚刚的小插曲，好像一切都没发生似的。
在他眼里，刚刚那伙人和眼前这两人相比可差远了。
“路上大概会遇上什么？”
鲍勃说：“几个哥布林部落可能会因为没吃的出来打劫，但是可能性很小，毕竟这趟咱们走的是商道。这可是千桅城的血管，那群贵族可看重这条路了，我担心的其实不是怪物。”
柯林点了点头说：“没问题。”

就算有问题，他也得挣房租啊。
“那后天上午马车照例来酒馆门口接你们，我们需要把货物运到北边的燧石村，然后在那里休息一天再回来。”
“能在村子里多待上一会儿吗？我想去周围摘点草药。”
“也行，不过最多只能待三天。”
说完，鲍勃就急匆匆的离开了酒馆。
“这趟过去送货，然后顺便搞点草药吧。”柯林喝了口免费的冰啤酒。
这下计划算是顺顺利利的定下来了。
“也行。”凯斯点点头：“接下来咱带你去对练。”
柯林也觉得接下来的日子必须要提升点战斗力，点点头就跟着对方去了。
两人走出酒馆，顺着大道朝着远离贫民窟的地方走去。
凯斯莫名有些沉默。
不想没话找话的柯林盯着自己的面板，脑中思绪不停。
-----------------
content_en:
With the crackling sound of bones, Case stood up.
The two-meter-tall orc stood in front of the visitor like a wall of flesh. He looked down at the visitor and said, "We can tear your jaw off, little one."
Colin, who was sitting on the side, held the wine glass on the table tightly, ready to help at any time.
Now that Case has taken the lead, as a teammate, he will naturally not back down...but he has never seen Case show such anger outside of the battle.
Although the adventurers who came over were a little frightened, they still refused to give in.
They have no choice. No job means no money, and no money means they can’t survive.
Instead of waiting for a job to come to you, take the initiative to find it.
Even if it means conflict.
"Old Black Heart, help!" Bob turned and shouted to the tavern owner: "Give these young men a glass of cold beer each to calm them down."
The boss waved his hand, and the tavern maid walked to the table holding a beer.
Several adventurers who came to grab a job immediately calmed down when they saw that the coachman knew the boss.
After hesitating for a while, he had no choice but to walk away silently.
Those who dare to run a tavern in the slums outside the city are generally not simple characters, and at least a few low-level adventurers must not be offended.
After the other party left, Case grunted twice and sat back down.
"That's it. It's the same eight silver coins as last time. Can you go north with me? It's about the same distance."
Bob ignored the incident, as if nothing had happened.
In his eyes, the group just now was far different from the two people in front of him.
"What might you encounter on the way?"
Bob said: "A few goblin tribes may come out to rob because they have no food, but the possibility is very small. After all, we are taking the trade road this time. This is the blood vessel of Thousand Mast City. Those nobles value this road. What I am worried about is not the monster."
Colin nodded and said, "No problem."
Even if there is a problem, he still has to earn rent.
"The carriage will pick you up at the entrance of the tavern as usual the day after tomorrow. We need to transport the goods to Flint Village in the north, and then rest there for a day before returning."
"Can you stay in the village for a little longer? I want to go around and pick some herbs."
"That's okay, but we can only stay for three days at most."
After saying that, Bob hurriedly left the tavern.
"We're going over here to deliver the goods, and then we'll get some herbal medicine on the way." Colin took a sip of the free cold beer.
Now the plan was settled smoothly.
"Okay." Case nodded: "I'll take you to sparring next."
Colin also felt that he must improve his combat effectiveness in the coming days, so he nodded and followed the opponent.
The two walked out of the tavern and walked along the avenue away from the slums.
Case was inexplicably silent.
Colin, who didn't want to run out of things to say, stared at his own panel, thinking non-stop in his mind.
